Use Claude to learn anything: pick your level, get quizzed one question at a time, then re-learn what you missed.

Use Claude to learn anything in 4 steps. Copy this tutor prompt.

1. Level - Set your level first: explain it like I am twelve.
2. Quiz - Then ask for three questions, one at a time.
3. Answer - Reply to each one. Claude checks your answer.
4. Fix - Ask it to re-teach whatever you missed. Then quiz again.

Needs: All plans
